sources.title: Python 3.10.22, 3.11.17, 3.12.15, 3.13.16 and 3.14.8 are now available! - Core Development - Discussions on Python.org
sources.content:
# Python 3.10.22, 3.11.17, 3.12.15, 3.13.16 and 3.14.8 are now available!

A full sweep of Python releases is here: Python 3.10.22, 3.11.17, 3.12.15, 3.13.16 and 3.14.8 are now available! One last lap around the Sun for Python 3.10, and security updates across all five series.

Get them here: [...] Python 3.10.22 and 3.11.17 are source-only. There are no Windows or macOS installers: 3.10.11 and 3.11.9 were the last releases in their respective series to include binary installers. These two releases contain security fixes rather than new features. [...] Thank you to everyone who contributed patches, reviewed changes, tested releases, reported bugs, or helped us get a release out when the universe seemed determined to prevent it. It has been a privilege to be your release manager for this series.

Python 3.11 still has another year of security fixes ahead of it, so you have not escaped me yet :slight_smile:

:slight_smile:

## We hope you enjoy the new releases!
